title: SG-6.1.1 Optional interaction field on the character schema
summary: Characters can carry an optional interaction (dialogue reference or action list) validated by characterSchema
description: Context: characterSchema in game/src/content/schema.ts has id, name, position, scale, layer and animations only, so an NPC cannot declare what happens when it is clicked. Desired behavior: add an optional interaction field holding a dialogue reference and/or a list of actions, reusing the existing actionSchema. Expected result: scene content with and without the field parses, and malformed interactions are rejected. Why: SG-6.1 data-driven NPCs need content-authored interaction.
acceptance_criteria: Given a character without interaction, When parsed with characterSchema, Then it still succeeds and interaction is undefined
Given a character with interaction.dialogue 'npc-greeting', When parsed, Then interaction.dialogue equals 'npc-greeting'
Given a character with an interaction actions list of valid actions, When parsed, Then the actions are preserved
Given an interaction with an action whose id is not allowed or with a non-string dialogue, When parsed, Then parsing fails
technical_constraints: Reuse actionSchema; do not invent new action ids
